principle: A platform change deploys only that platform unless a declared shared dependency changes.

ekodi-shell.note: Public service manifest plus navigation context only. Authorization remains server-side in each owning service.

my.database: Supabase person/workspace views and person-scoped portfolio data

sharedDependencies: Marketing AI through public service contract
future specialist AI modules through capability-scoped contracts
management.database: none in foundation release; browser-local non-sensitive module choices only; future management_* operational state namespace
management.note: Management is a platform-core orchestration surface. Customer types map to canonical Person + Space kinds; franchise is an organization-profile hierarchy, not a new global identity kind. External mutations stay disabled without official adapters and explicit human approval.

sharedDependencies: ekodi-shell public manifest and navigation shell
cafe.database: none in imagination phase; browser-local notes only
cafe.note: Future physical-place platform. Public copy must not imply an operating cafe before a verified opening state.

books.note: Bookstore owns catalog, storefront and commerce. It consumes 출판 only through an explicit public handoff and does not own publishing workflows.

publishing.database: none in first release; publishing workflows retain explicit human confirmation for external submission and distribution actions
publishing.note: Professional publishing service is separate from the bookstore. Cross-service access uses public or explicitly declared contracts only; private cross-service data access is forbidden.

education.database: none in first release; browser-local non-sensitive planning metadata only; future education_* namespace
education.note: Admission and Study are major workflow areas inside one Education platform, not separate deployment units. High-impact submission/payment actions remain human-confirmed and are disabled in the first release.

bible-conversation.database: Supabase bible_* namespace with RLS; private-by-default personal Journey, follow-up and explicit group sharing
bible-conversation.note: Today, Conversation, Journey and Together are workflow areas inside one Bible Conversation platform. Authenticated AI is routed through the provider-independent central User AI service; anonymous and AI-unavailable states retain a local non-AI Scripture conversation fallback. Pastoral authority is never delegated to AI.

life.database: Supabase life_* namespace with RLS; only user-explicit saved reflections are persisted
life.note: Today Question is the public brand and Life AI is the engine. Eight topic routes share one Life-to-Gospel core. Bible Conversation is a deeper Scripture handoff rather than a duplicate platform.

sharedDependencies: official public support-program sources through reviewed source adapters
support.database: none in first release; browser-local non-sensitive planning metadata only; future support_* namespace
support.note: Official-source-first opportunity analysis, grant workspace and form preparation. Submission, signature, agreement, payment, budget changes and settlement remain human-confirmed and are not autonomously executed.

sharedDependencies: financial institution services only through explicit reviewed contracts
money.database: none in first release; no sensitive financial identifiers persisted; future money_* namespace only after legal/security review
money.note: Financial cleanup decision support. Transfers, account closure, autopay changes, payments and other financial execution are disabled for autonomous AI and require explicit human confirmation through authorized financial channels.

social.database: ekodi-auth D1 via control-api with bundled static registry fallback

sharedDependencies: future device adapters via explicit energy integration contracts only
energy.database: none in first release; future energy_* namespace

sharedDependencies: future official order/POS/delivery-provider adapters through reviewed contracts only
delivery.database: none in MVP; browser-local non-sensitive delivery planning only; future delivery_* namespace
delivery.note: Delivery Hub AI is isolated as a path-scoped Worker route at /delivery, ahead of the existing ekodi.kr Custom Domain. It orchestrates existing order and delivery networks. External dispatch, payment, settlement, and provider mutations remain disabled until official adapters and explicit human confirmation are configured.

sharedDependencies: Marketing AI via public service contract
Finance API via explicit contract when enabled
Energy AI via public service contract
business.database: none in first release; future business_* namespace

finance.database: ekodi-auth D1 with finance_* table namespace

sharedDependencies: Toss Payments recurring billing when configured

storage-control.database: ekodi-auth D1 storage_* metadata only; encrypted Google refresh tokens; file content remains in Google Drive
storage-control.note: Primary is organization-bound. Secondary Google accounts are opt-in. Drive is archive/original storage, not a CDN; R2 remains the web-object/backup-copy layer.

marketing-domain-api.database: ekodi-auth D1 with marketing_* table namespace

sharedDependencies: official channel APIs through explicit user-authorized credentials
marketing-publishing-api.database: ekodi-auth D1 with marketing_brand_profiles and marketing_publication_* namespaces

site-core.note: Temporary shared Worker. Split by domain family in isolation v2.

service-proxy.note: Proxy changes are shared-edge changes and require regression verification of every routed domain.

sharedDependencies: marketing-publishing-api for immediate and scheduled distribution
marketing-ai.database: platform-specific external storage and control-api tenant data

rules: The full ecosystem deploy is manual-only.
Platform workflows must use path filters.
Shared edge runtimes must use a shared concurrency group to prevent overlapping production deploys.
A shared database migration is a shared-core change and may intentionally trigger more than one service verification.
No platform may read or write another tenant's private data without an explicit shared API contract.
Production verification must use the real public hostname.
Every new user-facing EKODI site must register in ekodi-service-manifest.js and consume the shared EKODI Shell or an equivalent reviewed Shell adapter.
Browser workspace context is navigation context only; protected services must re-authorize Person + Space + Role server-side.
Archive/original files belong in the primary Google Workspace Drive by default; optional secondary Google accounts never silently replace the primary archive.
Google Drive is not a CDN. Web-serving files and durable backup copies may be replicated to R2 when enabled.
The public bookstore brand is 에코디서점; the internal service id books is compatibility-only and must not become the public brand.
에코디서점 and 출판 are independent platforms; their integration is limited to public or explicitly declared handoff contracts.
